inputs.club_depth_charts: depth_lab/data/depth.json, parsed by session arena/3436db70-korea3 from 31 club-published pages captured 2026-11-13

_meta.join_rule: A row appears when the player listed at string 1 of a position in a club's own published depth chart also appears on the league's official Week 10 injury report for that club with a Game Status of Out, Doubtful or Questionable. The replacement is the next name the same club printed at the same position, in the club's own column order.
_meta.depth_cost: replacement_string - 1. It is a count of columns in a club's own publication, not a judgement about how good the replacement is. No ability, snap count or grade is attached to it anywhere in this repository.
_meta.not_known: No official publisher states who will start. A depth chart is the club's own ordering and carries no designation; the league's injury report carries a designation and no ordering. Nothing here predicts a lineup.
_meta.extension: Session arena/3436db70-korea3 joined Out and Doubtful only. Questionable is added here and reported in a separate column group so the two sets can be told apart.
_meta.absent_note: These four clubs had no injury table on the page at capture time. Whether that is a bye week, a page the league did not publish, or a chunk that was not served is NOT KNOWN and is not inferred.
